events.verdict: Horford (BOS) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Tatum (BOS) makes marginal contact with Griffin (DET) on the perimeter that does not affect his SQBR.
Irving (BOS) makes incidental contact with Smith's (DET) arm after the release of his jump shot that does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Griffin (DET) legally contests Tatum's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Drummond (DET) is firming up in a legal picking position in Tatum's (BOS) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Johnson (DET) slides his pivot foot before releasing the ball at the start of his dribble.
Brown (BOS) sets the screen in Drummond's (DET) path and does not deliver contact.
Smith (DET) briefly grasps Horford (BOS) and slides his hand off.
Irving (BOS) briefly grasps Griffin (DET) and slides his hand off.
Irving (BOS) makes marginal contact with Griffin (DET) during the pick that does not affect his FOM.
Griffin (DET) is firming up in a legal picking position in Irving's (BOS) path and does not deliver contact.
Irving (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position on Griffin's (DET) post move and shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Irving (BOS) gathers the loose ball and takes two steps.
Irving (BOS) recovers the ball after it is dislodged away by Drummond (DET) and he is allowed to dribble.
Brown (BOS) makes marginal contact with Drummond (DET) during the screen that does not affect his ability to defend.
Smith (DET) briefly engages Irving (BOS) with both hands, but contact is marginal and does not affect his SQBR.
LLB shows Drummond (DET) cleanly dislodges the ball from Irving (BOS) during his drive.
After Irving (BOS) recovers the loose ball, Drummond (DET) reaches in and makes contact with his arm that affects his SQBR.
Griffin (DET) sets the screen on Brown (BOS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Drummond (DET) commits a take foul on Morris (BOS).
Brown (BOS) briefly grasps Bullock (DET) with two hands before immediately correcting.
Tatum (BOS) extends his leg and intentionally kicks the ball during the inbound. RLS shows Tatum does not cross the boundary line when he makes contact with the ball.
Morris (BOS) commits a take foul on Griffin (DET).
Johnson (DET) releases the inbound pass within five seconds.
Griffin (DET) and Smart (BOS) make incidental contact during the inbound.
Morris (BOS) legally contests Smith's (DET) jump shot.
Calderon (DET) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
Smith (DET) and Smart (BOS) make incidental contact with one another during the loose ball situation.
Irving (BOS) gathers the ball and maintains his pivot foot.
Griffin (DET) dives for the ball and makes contact with Irving's (BOS) leg that dislodges him from his obtained position.
Drummond (DET) sets the screen in Irving's (BOS) path and does not deliver contact.
Morris (BOS) legally contests Bullock's (DET) jump shot.
Smith (DET) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
